name: research-methods-mcp
description: Research methods for AI assistants: R and Python code, method advice, and citations from open books.
long_description: Ask Claude how to analyze your data and get answers grounded in open books on causal inference, econometrics, experiments, marketing research, credit scoring, and AI. Choose a design for your research question, read the relevant sections, get runnable R and Python code, and get a reference list in APA, Chicago, MLA, Harvard, BibTeX, or RIS. Runs locally; no account or API key.

tools.name: choose_method
tools.description: Recommend methods for a research question, with assumptions, R and Python packages, and readings.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a section with its code, link, and citation.

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: Get runnable R, Python, or Julia code for a task.

tools.name: cite
tools.description: Format references in APA, Chicago, MLA, Harvard, BibTeX, or RIS.

tools.description: List the books and packages in the library.
